notes.title: Version 7.4 Released - New save system
notes.notes:
Version 7.4 has now been Released to Steam !

This updates includes some minor changes but most importantly it includes the new save system.  Now you can save & quit during a run and be able to resume your game at any time later, even after closing the game, turning off your PC etc.

If you don't see version 7.4 at the top left of the main menu in game, you can go to Properties->Local Files for the game listing in your Steam Library to 'Verify Integrity Of Game Files' and that will trigger a download of the update.

Have fun !
